reason: The 10-K filing for Coterra Energy Inc. does not contain any company-disclosed Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The filing contains extensive information about reserves (in MBoe, Bcf, MMBbl), production data, hedging activities, and financial performance, but does not provide any market size estimates or TAM disclosures for the energy sector or any specific market segments in which the company operates.
